quote_json: "the same as the state of v after argn."
notes: The compiler rejects the local read after assignment in an omitted conditional-call argument. The first-edition invocation transfer has no omitted-call exception and supplies the last argument's state; the second, third and fourth editions retain that rule. The assignment-check method is not invoked, so no uninitialized runtime value is asserted. The positive witness defines the call symbol, and the executed defined-symbol control checks its assigned value.
